en.title: ФГБУ ВНИИПО МЧС России — Orenburg branch
en.text: Research, testing, education, conferences and exhibitions in fire safety. The official institutional name is retained in Russian.

zh-hant.title: ФГБУ ВНИИПО МЧС России — 奧倫堡分部
zh-hant.text: 提供消防安全領域的科學研究、試驗、教育、會議及展覽資訊。機構官方名稱保留俄語。

en.title: About the branch
en.text: The Orenburg branch is a structural unit of the All-Russian Research Institute for Fire Protection of EMERCOM of Russia. Its work includes fire safety research and the development and implementation of fire protection equipment.

zh-hant.title: 關於分部
zh-hant.text: 奧倫堡分部隸屬於俄羅斯緊急情況部全俄消防科學研究所，從事消防安全研究，以及消防設備的研發與應用。

en.title: Research
en.text: This section brings together research activities, information about the testing ground and the section of the Scientific and Technical Council. Detailed source materials are available in Russian.

zh-hant.title: 科學研究
zh-hant.text: 本欄目彙集科學研究活動、試驗場及科學技術委員會分組的資訊。詳細原始資料以俄語提供。

en.title: Education
en.text: The branch publishes information about additional professional education and occupational safety training. The educational information section contains institutional details, documents, programmes and other published information.

zh-hant.title: 教育活動
zh-hant.text: 分部公佈繼續專業教育及職業安全培訓資訊。教育資訊欄目包含機構資料、文件、課程及其他已公開資訊。

en.title: Conferences and exhibitions
en.text: Conference information, registration and staff accounts are provided by the existing conference service. Conference records and applications remain in their original system until the planned migration is completed.

zh-hant.title: 會議與展覽
zh-hant.text: 會議資訊、註冊及工作帳戶由現有會議服務提供。完成計畫中的資料遷移前，會議及申請紀錄仍保留於原系統。

en.title: Contacts
en.text: Contact details and institutional information are published in the contact and institutional details sections. Please refer to the Russian source for the original information.

zh-hant.title: 聯絡方式
zh-hant.text: 聯絡方式及機構資訊公佈於相應欄目。原始資訊請參閱俄語來源。

en.title: Contact information
en.text: The Russian source lists the Research Department at 97 Sovetskaya Street, Orenburg, 460006. Telephone numbers: +7 (3532) 57-22-95, 57-24-84 and 57-27-15. The displayed email differs from the mailto link on the source page; the email address requires confirmation.

zh-hant.title: 聯絡資訊
zh-hant.text: 俄語來源列出的科學研究部門地址為：460006，奧倫堡市，蘇維埃街 97 號。電話：+7 (3532) 57-22-95、57-24-84、57-27-15。來源頁面顯示的電子郵件地址與郵件連結不同，電子郵件地址仍需確認。

en.title: Testing ground
en.text: The branch testing ground supports scientific experiments, research and training in fire prevention and firefighting. It is used for full-scale testing of fire protection equipment and technologies. The Russian source describes a 30-hectare site with more than 40 full-scale models and supporting facilities.

zh-hant.title: 試驗場
zh-hant.text: 分部試驗場用於防火與滅火領域的科學實驗、研究及培訓，並對消防設備及技術進行全尺寸試驗。俄語來源描述該場地面積為 30 公頃，設有超過 40 個全尺寸模型及配套設施。
